kits.name: Seamstep Vanguard
kits.text:
{
  "id": "aoc-rare-seamstep-vanguard",
  "game_id": "age-of-convergence",
  "name": "Seamstep Vanguard",
  "class_identity": {
    "rarity": "RARE",
    "role": "Mobile melee skirmisher and terrain controller",
    "primary_attribute": "AGI",
    "combat_identity": "A solo-capable frontline fighter who creates temporary footholds, launches attacks from unusual angles, and escapes retaliation by repositioning through terrain. The class survives through reliable movement, selective defense, and control of enemy approach routes rather than summoned allies.",
    "world_connection": "The class originated in the Split Cliffs, a mountain range physically merged with the Italian Alps during Convergence. Local fighters learned to navigate the sharp transitions between two incompatible geological formations.",
    "playstyle": "In combat, the Vanguard places footholds, attacks from favorable positions, and redirects incoming force into movement. Outside combat, the same footholds and structural awareness support climbing, crossings, exploration, and improvised rescue.",
    "resource_model": {
      "resource": "MP",
      "level_1_capacity": 45,
      "recovery": "Restore MP through the campaign's standard rest rules.",
      "attack_stat": "AGI",
      "ability_save_dc": "12 + AGI modifier"
    },
    "adventure_focus": "Combat, exploration, dangerous crossings, and short objective-driven expeditions.",
    "risk_profile": "The Vanguard can fight independently but must manage finite MP, positioning, and exposure to concentrated attacks. Temporary footholds do not prevent enemies from attacking the Vanguard."
  },
  "abilities": [
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-active-01",
      "name": "Faultline Strike",
      "activation": "Action",
      "group": "Active",
      "full_rules": "Choose one creature within 2 meters. Make a melee attack using AGI against its DEF. On a hit, deal 2d8 + AGI modifier physical damage. You may move up to 3 meters immediately before or after the attack without provoking opportunity attacks from that target. This movement can cross a gap up to 2 meters wide if the destination can support you. Costs 5 MP. Usable once per Action.",
      "flavor_text": "The Vanguard cuts across the ground's hidden seams and strikes from an unexpected angle."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-passive-01",
      "name": "Broken Ground Instinct",
      "activation": "Passive",
      "group": "Passive",
      "full_rules": "While conscious, you ignore movement penalties from ordinary rubble, loose stones, steep slopes, and uneven ground. Once during each of your turns, after moving at least 2 meters, gain +2 DEF against the next attack targeting you before the start of your next turn. The bonus ends after that attack resolves. Costs no MP.",
      "flavor_text": "Unstable ground becomes a source of balance rather than danger."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-reaction-01",
      "name": "Recoil Traverse",
      "activation": "Reaction",
      "group": "Reaction",
      "full_rules": "When a visible creature within 3 meters hits you with an attack, spend 4 MP and your Reaction before damage is applied. Reduce that attack's damage by 1d8 + AGI modifier, to a minimum of zero, then move up to 2 meters to a space you can occupy. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from the triggering creature. The triggering attack still hits. Usable once per round.",
      "flavor_text": "The Vanguard turns the impact into a sharp sideways escape."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-free-01",
      "name": "Instant Foothold",
      "activation": "Free Action",
      "group": "Free Action",
      "full_rules": "Once per turn, create one solid foothold at a visible point within 6 meters, attached to a surface or suspended no more than 3 meters from an existing solid surface. It is a 1-meter-wide horizontal platform that supports up to 200 kilograms for 2 rounds. You may immediately step up to 1 meter onto or off the foothold as part of this Free Action. One foothold created by you may exist at a time; creating another replaces it. Costs 2 MP.",
      "flavor_text": "A pale slab snaps into existence just long enough to catch a moving foot."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-utility-01",
      "name": "Survey the Fracture",
      "activation": "Utility, 1 minute",
      "group": "Utility",
      "full_rules": "Touch a solid structure or natural formation and spend 2 MP to sense major breaks, hidden cavities, load-bearing routes, and unstable sections connected through the material within 15 meters. Learn their approximate positions and whether each examined route can safely support a human-sized creature. The information reflects the structure's present condition. You may examine one connected structure per activation.",
      "flavor_text": "The Vanguard feels a map of pressures and empty spaces through their palm."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-utility-02",
      "name": "Lay the Crossing",
      "activation": "Utility, 1 Action",
      "group": "Utility",
      "full_rules": "Spend 6 MP to create up to four connected solid stepping platforms between visible points within 10 meters. Each platform is 1 meter wide, supports 200 kilograms, and lasts 10 minutes. Adjacent platforms may be separated by no more than 1 meter. The route may climb, descend, or turn around corners visible from the casting position. You can dismiss the entire route without an Action. One crossing route may exist at a time. This ability can be used during combat under the ordinary Action economy.",
      "flavor_text": "A temporary stairway unfolds across the empty space."
    }
  ],
  "utilities": [
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-utility-01",
      "name": "Survey the Fracture",
      "text": "Touch a connected solid structure for 1 minute and pay 2 MP to identify major cavities, structural weaknesses, and load-bearing routes within 15 meters. Useful for investigating ruins, identifying safe passages, finding concealed rooms, choosing climbing routes, or assessing damaged buildings."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-utility-02",
      "name": "Lay the Crossing",
      "text": "Use an Action and 6 MP to form four connected 1-meter platforms within 10 meters for 10 minutes, with 200-kilogram capacity per platform. Useful for crossing gaps, reaching elevated entrances, creating temporary access to equipment, bypassing flooded floors, or establishing evacuation paths."
    }
  ],
  "evolutions": [
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-evo-01",
      "parent_id": "aoc-sv-active-01",
      "name": "Angle Breaker",
      "text": "When Faultline Strike hits, you may choose to arrive on the opposite side of the target as part of its existing movement, provided the destination is within the original 3-meter movement allowance and can support you. After arriving, you may push the target 2 meters into a vacant space. This adds positional control without granting another attack or Action."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-evo-02",
      "parent_id": "aoc-sv-reaction-01",
      "name": "Shared Recoil",
      "text": "Recoil Traverse can also trigger when a visible ally within 3 meters is hit. The damage reduction applies to that ally, and the ally performs the ability's 2-meter movement. You still pay the original MP cost and Reaction. This changes the defensive ability into a targeted ally-protection option."
    },
    {
      "id": "aoc-sv-evo-03",
      "parent_id": "aoc-sv-utility-02",
      "name": "Hinged Crossing",
      "text": "When creating Lay the Crossing, you may designate one platform as a hinge. Once during the route's duration, you may rotate the connected route around that platform by up to 90 degrees with a 1-minute adjustment, repositioning the other platforms within the original 10-meter range. Creatures standing on the platforms move with them. This allows one established crossing to serve a second destination."
    }
  ]
}

The player fights directly while directing an independent major general and a limited force of useful subordinates. The sovereign specializes in relocating allies, controlling approaches, and delivering coordinated attacks.",

      "name": "The Last Harbor",

A permanent anchor-gate connects the domain to its chosen physical shoreline. The sovereign and authorized companions may enter or leave through the gate by spending 1 minute. The sovereign may relocate the anchor to a shoreline personally visited by performing a 1-hour ritual at the new location, once every 7 days. The domain itself has no offensive attacks outside its gate.",

        "major_generals": 1,
        "subordinate_units": 4,

      },

        "id": "ss-lh-general-01",
        "name": "Breakwater Admiral",

          "id": "ss-lh-mariners-line-haul",
          "name": "Line Haul",
          "activation": "Subordinate Unit Action",

Against an unwilling creature, make the unit's +4 attack roll against its DEF; on a hit, the target is pulled 2 meters instead. The unit uses its Action and cannot attack in the same turn.",
          "flavor_text": "Three spectral sailors cast a glowing hawser and haul in unison."
        }
      },
      "replenishment": {
        "resource": "Harbor Stores",

        "generation": "The domain produces 2 Harbor Stores at the end of each completed 24-hour period while its anchor-gate is intact and at least one subordinate unit remains assigned to upkeep.",
        "replacement_rule": "Replacing one destroyed subordinate unit requires 2 Harbor Stores and 8 uninterrupted hours at the repair dock. Restoring a damaged surviving subordinate unit to full HP requires 1 Harbor Store and 4 hours. The repair dock can process one unit at a time.",
